jobs_results.title: Customer Service & Sales Representative
jobs_results.description:
Full-Time - Independent Contractor | Remote | Latin America


 StratifyIQ is seeking a Customer Service & Sales Representative to join its growing team. This role combines customer support with active sales responsibilities, including inbound and outbound calls, SMS, and email communication. The ideal candidate has a background in BPO or call center environments, is comfortable managing a high volume of customer interactions, and has a sales-oriented mindset focused on turning conversations into business opportunities.


 Key Responsibilities


 
  Handle a high volume of customer interactions through inbound and outbound calls, SMS, and email.
  Provide excellent customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and maintaining positive customer relationships.
  Conduct outbound calls to follow up with leads, re-engage prospects, and generate new sales opportunities.
  Identify customer needs, recommend appropriate products or services, and convert leads into sales.
  Manage warm leads and maintain consistent follow-up across multiple channels to maximize conversion rates.
  Use Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Calendar, to manage communications, track activities, and organize daily workflows.
  Maintain accurate customer records, interaction logs, and sales pipeline updates in CRM systems.
  Meet performance targets related to customer satisfaction, response times, call volume, and sales conversions.
 
 Qualifications


 
  Previous experience in a BPO, call center, customer service, or sales environment.
  Proven experience handling high volumes of customer interactions across multiple communication channels.
  Strong outbound calling, lead follow-up, and sales closing skills.
  Experience using Google Workspace, particularly Gmail and Google Sheets.
  Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  Ability to multitask, manage competing priorities, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a results-driven mindset.
  Comfort working with CRM systems and performance-based KPIs.
 
 Preferred Qualifications


 
  Experience in sales-focused customer service or inside sales roles.
  Familiarity with CRM platforms, dialers, and customer communication tools.
  Experience managing warm leads, nurturing prospects, and following up through multiple channels.
 
 What Success Looks Like


 
  Customer inquiries are handled promptly, accurately, and professionally across all channels.
  Warm leads are followed up consistently and converted into sales at a strong rate.
  Customer satisfaction, response times, and call volume targets are met on a regular basis.
  CRM records and pipeline updates are complete, accurate, and current.
 
 Work Environment


 This is a full-time, fully remote role based in Latin America. The position suits someone who works well independently in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment and is comfortable balancing customer service with active sales responsibilities.


 What We Offer


 
  Full-time remote work
  Flexible paid time off
  Opportunities for career advancement
  Ongoing learning and professional development support
 
 Who We're Looking For


 We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused professional who combines strong service skills with a drive to close business. You should be comfortable making outbound calls, managing a high volume of interactions, following up consistently, and turning customer conversations into sales opportunities. If you are ready to grow within a collaborative and performance-oriented organization, this role offers the opportunity to make a measurable impact.

jobs_results.description:
Customer Service Representative | Peru | On-site | Nightshift

Here's the deal!

Helpware is a technology-driven company with offices in the USA, Ukraine, Mexico, and the Philippines that provides Customer Experience & Operational Support for modern companies. Our team of professionals is driven by the purpose of providing best-in-class value-adding services to our partners by leveraging our empowered teams, innovative solutions, and technologies.

Your day-to-day!

- Become an expert on the product, knowing all the specifics of its functioning.
- Perform Back-office activities related to the operational requirements.
- Autonomously manage assigned tasks, queues, support requests while maintaining productivity.
- Provide support to customers via email and/or chat in a timely and professional manner.
- Address customer inquiries, troubleshoot problems, and guide users through basic issue resolution steps.
- Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers at all times.
- Work on creating, updating, or adjusting customer accounts by documenting personal information.
- Collaborate with colleagues and management on best practices and insights about any aspect of the job or its duties.
- Document and track customer interactions, issues, and resolutions in CRM, online tools, and cloud based platforms.
- Process and prepare information for auditing and reporting purposes.
- Update internal and customer-facing knowledge bases.

•Convert clients' feedback into feature requests for the development of the product. • Escalate unresolved issues to client-defined escalation paths while maintaining ownership of the case until resolution.

- Effectively communicate technical information to non-technical users.
- Stay updated on product knowledge and be able to explain features, functionalities, and common troubleshooting steps.
- Other related tasks assigned by managers of the Client and/or Helpware.

What you need

- Advanced English
- At least 1 years of Customer Service experience
- Experience supporting customers through email and/or chat is highly preferred
- Excellent written communication skills with strong grammar and attention to detail
- Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
- Ability to remain calm and professional when handling difficult situations
- Comfortable multitasking across multiple systems and applications
- Reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
- Availability to work assigned schedules, including weekends if required
- Availability to work a night shift ( 2:00 AM – 11:00 AM local time).

What you get

- Competitive salary
- Hybrid role
- Paid training
- Career growth opportunities
- Supportive team environment
- Work with an international company and general clients

jobs_results.job_title: Coordinador de Customer Service y Distribución
jobs_results.description:
¡Únete al equipo de Tattersall Perú! Estamos en búsqueda de un(a) Asistente de Customer Service y Distribución para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de Operaciones. Buscamos una persona organizada, proactiva, con orientación al cliente y muchas ganas de aprender y desarrollarse profesionalmente.

 Asistente de Customer Service y Distribución

Resumen del Puesto

Estamos en la búsqueda de un Asistente de Customer Service y Distribución proactivo y organizado, cuya función principal será garantizar la excelencia en la atención y el seguimiento de los pedidos de nuestros clientes. El rol abarca desde la recepción y facturación de los pedidos hasta la coordinación logística del despacho, la entrega final y el cierre documental correspondiente.

Principales Responsabilidades

 Gestionar de manera eficiente y dar seguimiento continuo a todos los pedidos recibidos de los clientes. Emitir la documentación comercial necesaria, incluyendo facturas y guías de remisión. Coordinar las operaciones de despacho y transporte con el área de almacén y los proveedores logísticos. Verificar la entrega de los productos y gestionar los documentos de recepción. Proporcionar soporte integral al equipo comercial y atender consultas y requerimientos de los clientes.Perfil Requerido

 Egresados o bachilleres de Administración, Contabilidad, Ingeniería Industrial, Logística o carreras afines. Experiencia mínima deseable de 6 meses a 1 año en atención de pedidos, facturación o funciones administrativas similares. Conocimientos de facturación electrónica y Excel. Capacidad para la resolución de problemas y la toma de decisiones. Capacidad para trabajar de forma colaborativa en equipo y de manera autónoma.*Indicar pretenciones salariales
